## `neuro.uint8Array.copyWithin`

Instance method on `Uint8Array.prototype`.

> Returns the this object after copying a section of the array identified by start and end
> to the same array starting at position target

## Signatures

```ts
copyWithin(input: { uint8Array: <receiver>; target: number; start: number; end?: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<Uint8Array>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Uint8Array.prototype.copyWithin` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
